profile.description: Qassim Cement Company manufactures and sells cement and related products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland, Portland pozzolana, sulphate resistant, limestone, and finishing cement products, as well as cement derivatives and supplements. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Buraydah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
